quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 2,123,930,905.00, up 15.97% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 231,363,263.59, up 51.20%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 225,467,547.01, up 104.99%; operating cash flow RMB 266,205,570.27, up 91.02%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 448,133,557.32, Q2 RMB 523,583,462.17, Q3 RMB 546,336,662.22, Q4 RMB 605,877,223.29; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 93,150,995.41. The company says the share of high-value-added products rose steadily and that orders for its high-speed cables and connection products grew rapidly as it pushed leading-customer certifications.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spending RMB 67,355,924.20 (+2.70%), 3.17% of revenue, 192 R&D staff. In 2025 the company completed development of single-lane 448Gb/s high-speed transmission cable, PCIe 6.0, MCIO 6.0 and matching connectors. Projects completed by December 2025: 800Gb/s active high-speed interconnect assemblies for data-center switches (active copper for server-to-ToR links), PCIe 5.0 512GT/s high-speed interconnect assemblies, 32GT/s in-server DA-CEM assemblies, PCIe 5.0 Gen-Z connectors, single-lane 224Gb/s parallel high-speed transmission cable (up to 60GHz, the cable for 1.6Tb/s assemblies) and an ultra-high-density cabling system for 800Gb/s fiber interconnect.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 67,355,924.20 (3.17% of revenue); 448Gb/s single-lane cable development completed

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (annual report): the funds from the December 2025 share placement are going to a Thailand production base construction project (total investment RMB 66,000.00 ten-thousand; RMB 11,220.10 ten-thousand invested in advance by year-end 2025) and a high-speed cable and connection products smart-manufacturing project (total investment RMB 43,199.95 ten-thousand; RMB 15,619.50 ten-thousand invested in advance). The Thailand plant construction project (budget RMB 235,872,000.00) was 15.00% complete at year-end 2025; construction in progress totalled RMB 102,773,742.02, incl. RMB 74,825,142.79 of machinery awaiting commissioning. Part of the Thailand base operates normally; its subsidiary had 2025 revenue RMB 7,821.06 ten-thousand and a net loss of RMB 1,501.06 ten-thousand. The company says the domestic project's equipment purchase, installation and commissioning are accelerating.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand base project RMB 66,000.00 ten-thousand; high-speed cable project RMB 43,199.95 ten-thousand; Thailand plant 15.00% complete

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company plans to focus on high-speed copper cables and assemblies, automotive Ethernet cables and assemblies, robot cables and assemblies, optical cabling systems and 10G cabling systems, to speed up capacity release and market expansion of high-value-added products, and to advance construction of the Thailand production base; it targets AI computing centers, data centers and industrial smart manufacturing as key applications.
